mapper.sql: id, user_id, weight, height, systolic_pressure, diastolic_pressure, blood_sugar, heart_rate, blood_lipid, oxygen_saturation, body_temperature, remark, record_time, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_record ( user_id, weight, height, systolic_pressure, diastolic_pressure, blood_sugar, heart_rate, blood_lipid, oxygen_saturation, body_temperature, remark, record_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{weight}, #{height}, #{systolicPressure}, #{diastolicPressure}, #{bloodSugar}, #{heartRate}, #{bloodLipid}, #{oxygenSaturation}, #{bodyTemperature}, #{remark}, #{recordTime}, NOW() )
